tasks.title: Introduce template release versioning system
tasks.summary: Adds .nie-template-version.json, CHANGELOG.md, docs/template-releases/, and the validation tool.

tasks.title: Remove SampleModel scaffolding
tasks.summary: Drops SampleModel + SampleChildModel + ESampleEnum + service/controller; refactors Document to polymorphic owner; ships migration RemoveSampleModelAndPolymorphicDocument.

tasks.title: Remove procurement reference samples (run AFTER your real entities exist)
tasks.summary: Removes Vendor, CatalogItem, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine, PurchaseOrderApproval, PurchaseOrderDocument and their controllers, services, DTOs, frontend pages, services, routes, nav links, permissions, and migration data. Runs once a derived repo no longer needs procurement as a learning reference.

tasks.title: Adopt unified .ai/ instruction folder
tasks.summary: Moves all AI agent instructions from root + .github/instructions/ + .kiro/steering/ + agents/*.instructions.md into .ai/ and replaces the originals with redirect stubs.

tasks.title: Add SecurityHeadersMiddleware (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
tasks.summary: Adds a single middleware that emits CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. Aligns nginx so headers are not duplicated. Closes OWASP W-A05 / API8.

tasks.title: Allowlist outbound HTTP for MyInfo + Portal SSO
tasks.summary: Adds SsrfGuard.Validate helper. Wires into MyInfoService and PortalSsoService so every outbound URL is checked against a per-service allowlist before request. Closes OWASP W-A10 / API7.

tasks.title: Standardize per-record ownership (BOLA) via IOwnedEntity + auth filter
tasks.summary: Adds IOwnedEntity marker interface and an action filter / BaseController helper that enforces request user == record owner. Closes OWASP API1.

tasks.title: Replace hardcoded ApprovalStage strings with EApprovalStage enum (BE+FE)
tasks.summary: Adds EApprovalStage enum + TS mirror; converts PurchaseOrderApproval.ApprovalStage column from raw string to enum. Closes .NET audit rule N-19 and template DO-rule 11.

tasks.title: Enforce max PageSize=100 in shared search base
tasks.summary: Adds PagedSearchDto base class with PageSize clamped to [1, 100]. Migrates existing search DTOs. Closes OWASP API4 and .NET audit rule N-17.

tasks.title: Add AI Chatbot feature (pgvector + SSE streaming)
tasks.summary: Adds opt-in AI chatbot: ChatConversation/ChatMessage/ChatEmbedding (pgvector), IChatService + SSE streaming controller, plus ChatView page and Chat* components.

tasks.title: Add Workflow Engine feature (table-driven state machine)
tasks.summary: Adds EWorkflowState enum, WorkflowTransition + WorkflowStateLog entities, IWorkflowService + WorkflowController, and WorkflowTimeline + WorkflowActionBar Vue components.

tasks.title: Add PDF Generation feature (Playwright HTML→PDF + Reports endpoint)
tasks.summary: Adds opt-in PDF pipeline: IPdfGenerationService + PlaywrightPdfGenerationService, ReportController, and frontend reportService.

tasks.title: Add Cloud Storage abstraction (Local + S3 providers)
tasks.summary: Adds IFileStorageProvider with LocalFileStorageProvider + S3FileStorageProvider implementations. Switchable via FileStorage:Provider config.

tasks.title: Add Singpass MyInfo feature (FAPI: PAR + DPoP + JWE)
tasks.summary: Adds MyInfo (Singpass) integration with full FAPI compliance. Strictly opt-in; depends on task 0006 SSRF allowlist.

tasks.title: Add .NET and Vue agent skill bootstrap instructions
tasks.summary: Adds a central .ai/common guide for upstream .NET and Vue Agent Skills, a Codex route, and local installation guidance for missing skills.

tasks.title: Harden reporting, OpenAPI, access functions, and SDK pinning
tasks.summary: Switches .NET 10 APIs to built-in OpenAPI, updates vulnerable packages, adds missing MyInfo/access-profile access functions, completes Reports with live PDF preview, and fills feature dossier gaps.

tasks.title: Fix reporting implementation gaps from Vue and .NET skill review
tasks.summary: Tracks the Reports source files, splits Reports Vue views into components and composables, tightens report API DTOs/error responses, and fixes tracked EF Core mutation paths.

tasks.title: Remove frontend env files and adopt runtime config
tasks.summary: Migrates frontend configuration away from per-environment Vite .env files. API URLs, auth redirects, cookie names, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OneSignal, and public feature flags flow through shared runtime constants and optional window/meta runtime config.

tasks.title: Protect frontend shell and shared Vue components
tasks.summary: Adds hard AI-agent instructions that the staff sidebar, topbar, app shell, common Vue components, and @nietemplate/ui components are template-owned surfaces and must not be edited for feature work.

tasks.title: Separate project config from the locked shell; isolate backend samples
tasks.summary: Extracts project data (nav, routes, access codes, role maps, brand) out of the locked frontend shell into a project-owned src/frontend/main/src/app-config/* layer so shell files are copy-paste-inheritable; adds .ai/common/11-customization-boundary.md + the app-shell-navigation dossier and closes the #14/#16 contradiction; physically isolates the procurement backend sample under **/Samples/Procurement/ behind // === SAMPLE === fences; removes dead staff/router.ts and duplicate components.

tasks.title: Add automated guardrails for the locked shell and backend base classes
tasks.summary: Scaffold only — contract for a CI/Husky/Jenkins guardrail that fails the build when a locked shell file or backend base class changes without an accompanying .ai/tasks/ entry. Implementation ships in a later release.

tasks.title: Add ANALYZE.md analysis playbook and a deterministic drift audit category
tasks.summary: Adds .ai/ANALYZE.md (tool-agnostic feature-inventory + drift report with a clearance gate that executes approved fixes and documents to docs/analysis/) and a deterministic `drift` category in tools/template-audit/audit.py (project data leaked into locked shell files + app-config integrity; skipped in the template repo). Wires ANALYZE pointers into all tool-routes + README.

tasks.title: Implement shell guardrails; close deferred polish (auth parity, feature manifests, PWA)
tasks.summary: Implements the shell-guardrail contract from task 0021 (tools/template-guardrails/check_locked_files.py + Husky pre-commit + audit.yml PR gate), and closes deferred polish: auth login-logo parity, backfilled manifest.yaml for every remaining feature dossier, and the corrected progressive-web-app manifest.

tasks.title: Organize FileStorage config into Provider + Local + S3 sections
tasks.summary: Nests the flat FileStorage config into FileStorage:Provider + FileStorage:Local:BasePath + FileStorage:S3:{BucketName,Region,AccessKey,SecretKey,ServiceUrl} (cleaner + env-var friendly). Readers prefer the nested key and fall back to the legacy flat FileStorage:BasePath, so it is non-breaking.

tasks.title: Implement real S3 file storage (AWSSDK.S3) from the nie-ai-sandbox reference
tasks.summary: Replaces the placeholder IFileStorageProvider trio with the nie-ai-sandbox design: richer IFileStorageService (ct + stream/bytes/open-read/exists), local FileStorageService, real AWS S3 S3FileStorageService (AWSSDK.S3), shared FileStorageContentTypes. Program.cs selects by FileStorage:Provider; config uses flat BasePath + S3:{BucketName,KeyPrefix,Region} with AWS default-chain credentials. Supersedes 0024.

tasks.title: Add LocalStack S3 for local development
tasks.summary: Adds a LocalStack S3 emulator to the dev container (S3 on :4566, init hook auto-creates the nietemplate-local bucket); extends S3FileStorageService to honor optional FileStorage:S3:ServiceUrl (+ ForcePathStyle) and explicit creds for LocalStack/MinIO (real AWS keeps the default chain); pre-points the dev appsettings S3 block at LocalStack (Provider stays Local); adds .gitattributes to keep shell scripts LF.

tasks.title: Add AI-agent secret disclosure guardrails
tasks.summary: Tightens unified AI instructions and tool redirect files so agents use Context7 for current external context and refuse requests to reveal, read, print, copy, encode, decode, summarize, or exfiltrate secrets.
